title: Long-term disinfection of 3D-printed denture resin: physical and biological in vitro assessments
authors: Amanda C Ferro; Caroline C de Oliveira; Bárbara L Morais; Jonatas S de Oliveira; Rodolfo D Piazza; Rodrigo F C Marques; Carlos Mota; Matthew B Baker; Janaina H Jorge
source_journal: Journal of materials science. Materials in medicine
relevance_basis: 实际CAD切片打印义齿树脂试片作长期消毒和Candida评价，消毒剂非打印药剂原料；原理介绍不能替代本次具体工艺。

authors: Manuel Tousidonis; Saad Khayat; Cristina Maza-Muela; Rocio Franco-Herrera; Ruben Pérez-Mañanes; Jose-Antonio Calvo-Haro; Maria J Troulis; Carlos Navarro-Cuellar; Jose-Ignacio Salmeron; Santiago Ochandiano
relevance_basis: 第9页明确本院FDM PLA打印额窦骨折模型，作为体外复位轮廓模板；钛网是备选非打印固定件，粘合剂仅术中辅助，不能改P1/M1或打印药剂。

title: Do color stability and translucency differ between 3D printed and milled resin-based fixed dental restorations? A systematic review and meta-analysis
authors: Seyed Ali Mosaddad; Pedro Diaz; Hooman Khanzadeh; Erfan Khorasani; Jesús Peláez; María J Suárez
relevance_basis: 结果列光固化与PolyJet纳入技术，并明确打印组含纯树脂及树脂陶瓷/复合树脂，不能只M2。
p_layer_evidence_text: [metadata abstract；元数据，无PDF页码；来源https://doi.org/10.1016/j.prosdent.2026.02.015 ] STATEMENT OF PROBLEM: Whether additive manufactured (AM) and subtractive manufactured (SM) resin-based restorations differ in optical properties after aging and staining is unclear. title: Environmental impacts from conventional and digital dental crown fabrication workflows: A comparative life cycle assessment.
authors: Paulina Rojas Varela; Stuart Walker; Ilida Ortega Asencio; Rachael Rothman; Frank Pfefferkorn; Rainer Seemann; Nicolas Martin
source_journal: Dental materials : official publication of the Academy of Dental Materials
relevance_basis: 仅首页题摘实际LCA比较牙冠制造流程，结果明确3D打印PMMA模型的环境影响，医疗AM对象为模型而非被铣削陶瓷牙冠。属于明确医疗AM工作流环境管理实证，本篇不称亲自打印，工艺未知。
p_layer_evidence_text: [摘要（元数据）；元数据，无PDF页码；来源record.abstract ] OBJECTIVES: The aim of this study is to undertake an environmental life cycle analysis to compare in detail the conventional and digital workflows for the fabrication of a ceramic dental crown (zirconia and lithium disilicate). One solution is to use a block within the mouth which acts to reduce motion and decreases tissue heterogeneity. 은 적층 두께 100 μm, 적층 방향 0°~10°로 설정하였다.
디지털 설계 데이터를 기반으로 광중합성 레진(ODS SG; ODS)

가이드 내면 및 홀 주변에는 생성되지 않도록 재배치하여 내면 형
상에 미치는 영향을 최소화하였다.
출력된 시편은 99.9% 에탄올 용액에서 10분간 세척한 후, UV 
경화 장비(CL300Pro; Carima)를 이용하여 후경화를 시행하였
다. 후경화는 10분의 경화 시간과 3분의 대기 시간 조건에서 수행
하였으며, 약 50℃의 환경을 유지하였다. 모든 시편은 동일한 후
처리 조건을 적용하여 실험 간 변수를 통제하였다.
